addr: St. Paul's English School, 3rd Cross Rd, 3rd Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

rev.t: Good spacious hall with clean well maintained amenities.

It’s a bit of a weird hall, the hall itself is smaller than the dining hall which feels weird. But it’s kinda good, lighting is good and well ventilated also. It’s maintained well and everything looks clean. …

The hall is decent for conducting a mid size function. Has a balcony on 3 sides if space in the hall is Insufficient. There is a separate dining hall with a capacity for 350 pax. No food & drink allowed inside the hall. Hence uts maintained very well
